# n3wth/kit

> Component registry for React, built on shadcn's registry protocol.

## Quick Start

Install any component via shadcn CLI:

```
npx shadcn add https://kit.n3wth.com/r/button.json
```

Add AI context pack for Cursor:

```
curl -o .cursorrules https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/cursorrules
```

## Registry

**Base URL:** https://kit.n3wth.com/r/
**Manifest:** https://kit.n3wth.com/r/registry.json

49 items total:
- 1 design system style (n3wth)
- 1 utility (cn)
- 32 UI components
- 4 blocks (nav, footer, hero, section)
- 11 hooks

## UI Components

accordion, animated-text, avatar, badge, button, card, character, code-block, command-box, composite-shape, dropdown, error-boundary, hamburger-icon, icon, input, label, mobile-drawer, modal, nav-link, noise-overlay, progress, scroll-indicator, separator, shape, skeleton, speech-bubble, switch, tabs, textarea, theme-toggle, toast, tooltip

## Blocks

footer, hero, nav, section

## Hooks

use-button-pulse, use-count-up, use-keyboard-shortcuts, use-media-query, use-page-transition, use-reduced-motion, use-scroll-reveal, use-stagger-list, use-text-reveal, use-theme, use-toast

## Install Patterns

Single component:
```
npx shadcn add https://kit.n3wth.com/r/button.json
```

Multiple components:
```
npx shadcn add https://kit.n3wth.com/r/button.json https://kit.n3wth.com/r/card.json https://kit.n3wth.com/r/input.json
```

Design system style (installs color tokens + cn utility):
```
npx shadcn add https://kit.n3wth.com/r/n3wth.json
```

## AI Context Packs

Context packs teach AI coding tools about this design system:

- **Cursor:** https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/cursorrules
- **AGENTS.md:** https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/AGENTS.md
- **MCP config:** https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/mcp.json
- **Structured JSON:** https://kit.n3wth.com/ai/components.json

## MCP Server

For tools supporting Model Context Protocol:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "n3wth-kit": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "shadcn@latest", "registry:mcp"],
      "env": {
        "REGISTRY_URL": "https://kit.n3wth.com/r/registry.json"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Design System

Flat, minimal, iOS-inspired. No shadows or gradients unless specified. Ships with light and dark themes via CSS custom properties.

Key tokens:
- Primary: White buttons with dark text
- Background: Near-black (#08090b dark, #ffffff light)
- Text: High contrast, 3 levels (ink, ink-dim, ink-faint)
- Borders: Subtle rails (rail, rail-strong)
- Radius: 0.625rem default

## Supported AI Tools

- v0 (Vercel)
- Cursor
- Windsurf
- Lovable
- Cline
- Any MCP-compatible tool
